## Summary

Adds the peasant-side CLI for pulling transcripts from the upstream Village, allowed only for logged-in users (closes #81). A logged-in user can pull a single transcript they own or that is group-shared with them (by bare UUID or pasted village web URL), list what is pullable remotely and what has been pulled locally, render a pulled transcript in the terminal via the existing `sessions context` renderer, and sync OTHER users' annotations on their own pushed transcripts (foreign-marked, own-authored excluded). Pulled artifacts land in a separate `village-pulls/` namespace + new V34 provenance tables — never in `peasant-sync/` or the `sessions` table, so local analytics are untouched. Originating REQUEST: Beads `unified-schema-7morn`; URD: `unified-schema-whqqg`.

| Command | Function | Auth |
|---|---|---|
| `peasant village transcripts pull <uuid\|url>` | pull transcript + annotations (`--force`, `--dry-run`, `--json`, `--quiet`, `--verbose`) | login required |
| `peasant village transcripts list` | remote pullable listing (own + approved-group-shared; public excluded) | login required |
| `peasant village transcripts list --local` | local pulled inventory | offline |
| `peasant village transcripts context <ref>` | render a pulled transcript (display-only `TurnsToEntries` projection into the `sessions context` renderer) | offline |
| `peasant village annotations sync [--session]` | fetch others' annotations on your pushed transcripts | login required |

## Testing
- [x] Created tests
- [x] Updated tests
- [x] Tested via integration / simulation
- [x] Tested manually (describe how)

```bash
make check     # fmt + vet + ast-grep + full -race suite (includes: pkg/schema constructor/wire tests,
               # httptest client tests incl. 304/ErrNotModified, V34 migration tests, PullStore atomicity
               # (TRIGGER-poisoned mid-batch rollback), pipeline round-trips with MemFS + FailingFS
               # (compensation + compensation-failure branches), CLI 5x2 auth matrix with positive offline
               # cells, stub-village CLI completion tests incl. --dry-run zero-mutation, output-equivalence

make e2e       # podman: real Postgres + MinIO + real village ./cmd/server + real peasant CLI.
               # TestPullRoundTripE2E (~10s): second village user, 401 on all pull routes, pull by UUID+URL,
               # up-to-date (manifest byte-stability) / --force (byte-change), public-but-unshared => not-found,
               # foreign-marked annotation sync with own-exclusion, table-level pollution gate, sandbox isolation.
```

- Companion village PR: peasant-labs/village#16 (pull surface: AuthRequired routes, canPullTranscript, content_hash/ETag)

## Changes

### pkg/schema (separate module)
- New pull wire types: `TranscriptID` newtype + validating constructor, `PullTranscriptInfo`, `PullListResponse`, `PullAnnotation` (embeds `AnnotationSummary` + author identity)
- `SchemaVersionResponse` gains the pull contract window (`pullContractVersion`/`minPullContractVersion`, omitempty)
- `type ContractVersion string` with zero-churn `PushContractVersion = ContractVersion` alias; specs regenerated via `cmd/schema-gen`

### internal/village (new package)
- `VillageClient` + negotiation helpers relocated from `internal/push` (zero behavior change; push delegates)
- 4 pull GETs (pure data calls) + explicit `NegotiatePull` stage (missing window ⇒ actionable village-too-old error — stricter than push)
- Sentinels: `ErrNotModified` (304), `ErrPullNotFound`, `ErrPullContractIncompatible`

### internal/store
- Migration V34: `pulled_transcripts` + `pulled_annotations` (composite `(village_host, …)` PKs, STRICT, `retracted_at` schema-only)
- `PullStore`: single-txn atomic `CommitPull`, `UpsertPulledAnnotations` with payload-compare `skipped` semantics

### internal/pull (new package)
- Staged pipeline: RESOLVE → AUTH-CHECK → NEGOTIATE → FETCH-META → DIFF → DOWNLOAD(temp) → FETCH-ANNOTATIONS → WRITE(rename) → DB-TX → REPORT; all network I/O before any local mutation; compensating removal (cache doctrine)
- Idempotency: `servedETag` (verbatim If-None-Match token) split from raw `servedBlobHash`; `--dry-run` post-DIFF short-circuit

### internal/e2e + internal/testutil + docs

### Post-review feedback wave (design-phase ratified, reviewed 0/0/0, UAT-accepted)
- **OpenAPI versioning**: village-api spec bumped to **0.2.0** (pull surface is additive ⇒ minor); doc-surface semver policy documented in `pkg/schema/openapi/doc.go`; all spec versions single-sourced from consts (info.version, filenames, display labels, test keys all derive)
- **Legacy publish spec retired (option B)**: `BuildOpenAPISpec`/`BuildJSONSchema` + `openapi-0.1.0.*` artifacts deleted; `PublishRequest` is now **extracted from the village-api spec** into `specs/publish-request-0.2.0.schema.json` (JSON Schema 2020-12, 24 bundled `$defs`), pinned by a 16-case enforcement-parity test against the frozen legacy schema (village vendors the new artifact — see village PR)
- **YAML test fixtures** (agentfilter-style): `pkg/schema/testdata/pull/` — hoisted named axes (3 casings × 5 ref forms = 15 generated valid cases), category-attached expectations, first-class `negative_lookalikes`, exported generators (`LoadPullRefFixtures`), meta-tests with coverage floors, golden `manifest.example.json` shape-pinned against the real `PullManifest`; `testutil` canonical values re-export from the fixture
- **Parser fix found by the fixtures**: `ParseTranscriptRef` now requires the canonical `/transcripts/<uuid>` path shape — previously any URL ending in a UUID parsed, so `/users/<uuid>` and `…/annotations/<uuid>` could silently pull the wrong transcript; now rejected actionably (lookalikes live-asserted)
- **Docs**: `docs/pull.md` (architecture: component map, 4 sequence diagrams, allowed/denied tables with per-row test citations) + `docs/auth.md` (whole auth model incl. the `canViewTranscript` vs `canPullTranscript` matrix); regenerated `docs/cli/*` for the pull-family commands

## Blast Radius

- **Additive CLI surface** — no existing command changed; push/login/logout untouched.
- **`internal/push` → `internal/village` relocation** is mechanical (verified byte-identical helper bodies; all push tests unchanged and green).
- **pkg/schema**: additive types + omitempty response fields — wire-compatible with existing consumers; `PushContractVersion` is now an alias (type identity preserved, all existing uses compile unchanged). Requires a version bump for the village to consume (see Reviewer Notes).
- **DB**: V34 is additive (two new tables); `sessions`/analytics untouched — enforced by the e2e pollution gate (table fingerprints byte-identical across pulls).
- **Pulled data is a re-fetchable cache**: any files↔DB divergence is repaired by re-pull `--force`; nothing user-owned is ever overwritten.

|---|---|---|
| Pull visibility | own + approved-group-shared ONLY (public DENIED) | user-elected at URE; pull is deliberately narrower than web `canViewTranscript`; ABAC/collectives seam for later |
